name: Taormina (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of light blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Taormina (a centaur on light blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Taormina, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Taormina arms — centaur on light blue, crowned, within branches
